claims.claim: urllib3 can automatically retry idempotent requests.
claims.citation: urllib3 can automatically retry idempotent requests

claims.claim: The urllib3 mechanism that retries idempotent requests also handles redirects.
claims.citation: This same mechanism also handles redirects

claims.claim: urllib3 retries can be controlled using the retries parameter to request().
claims.citation: You can control the retries using the retries parameter to request()

claims.claim: By default, urllib3 will retry requests 3 times.
claims.citation: By default, urllib3 will retry requests 3 times

claims.claim: By default, urllib3 will follow up to 3 redirects.
claims.citation: By default, urllib3 will retry requests 3 times and follow up to 3 redirects

claims.claim: Specifying an integer for the retries parameter of urllib3's request() changes the number of retries.
claims.citation: To change the number of retries just specify an integer

claims.claim: Specifying retries=False in urllib3 disables all retry logic.
claims.citation: To disable all retry and redirect logic specify retries=False

claims.claim: Specifying retries=False in urllib3 disables all redirect logic.
claims.citation: To disable all retry and redirect logic specify retries=False

claims.claim: Specifying redirect=False in urllib3 disables redirects.
claims.citation: To disable redirects but keep the retrying logic, specify redirect=False

claims.claim: Specifying redirect=False in urllib3 keeps the retrying logic.
claims.citation: To disable redirects but keep the retrying logic, specify redirect=False

claims.claim: A urllib3 Retry instance can be used for more granular control of how requests are retried.
claims.citation: For more granular control you can use a Retry instance

claims.claim: A urllib3 Retry instance can be configured to do a total of 3 retries but limit to only 2 redirects.
claims.citation: to do a total of 3 retries, but limit to only 2 redirects

claims.claim: A urllib3 Retry instance can disable exceptions for too many redirects.
claims.citation: You can also disable exceptions for too many redirects

claims.claim: When a urllib3 Retry instance disables exceptions for too many redirects, urllib3 just returns the 302 response.
claims.citation: disable exceptions for too many redirects and just return the 302 response

claims.claim: In urllib3, the retry policy can be specified at the PoolManager level.
claims.citation: you can specify the retry at the PoolManager level

claims.claim: Specifying the retry policy at the urllib3 PoolManager level makes all requests subject to the same retry policy.
claims.citation: If you want all requests to be subject to the same retry policy, you can specify the retry at the PoolManager level

claims.claim: A urllib3 PoolManager-level retry policy can be overridden by specifying retries to request().
claims.citation: You can still override this pool-level retry policy by specifying retries to request()
